name: Myth of Slayer
source:
One day, mysterious portals appeared in every corner of the world, and many strange monsters that should not exist in reality came out of those portals, killing every living thing in their way. Some people were awakened to become slayers, and they fought to drive those monsters away successfully. But that was not the end, but the beginning of everything. You will play as an MC in a world three years after the invasion. What will happen to your story and your fate? Only you can decide.

[From [url=https://oldcatlyk4n.itch.io/mythofslayer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天，神秘的传送门出现在世界的各个角落，许多现实中不应该存在的奇怪怪物从那些传送门中走出来，杀死了每一个挡道的生灵。有些人觉醒成为了杀手，他们奋力将那些怪物成功赶走。但这并不是结束，而是一切的开始。你将在入侵三年后的世界中扮演MC。你的故事和命运将会发生什么？只有你可以决定。

[来自[url=https://oldcatlyk4n.itch.io/mythofslayer]Itch.io[/url]]
